Outbound that fills your pipeline, not spam folders

Most outbound fails because it goes to the wrong people with the wrong message. Our framework uses AI to find the prospects who actually match your ideal client, then runs personalised email and LinkedIn campaigns that start real sales conversations and build measurable pipeline.

Book a free growth call See what's included

Best for

  • B2B companies that need more qualified meetings without hiring more SDRs
  • Teams whose current outbound gets ignored, bounced or marked as spam
  • Sales-led businesses that want pipeline they can forecast

The 3-part system behind it

Targeting, messaging and channels work together, so every touchpoint builds on the last instead of starting cold.

  1. 01

    AI-powered targeting

    The right people, not just more people.

    AI researches and filters your market down to decision-makers who match your ideal-client profile and show signs they're ready to buy.

  2. 02

    Multichannel sequences

    Email and LinkedIn, working together.

    Personalised cold email and LinkedIn outreach run side by side, so prospects see you in more than one place and replies come from both channels.

  3. 03

    Pipeline handoff

    From reply to booked meeting.

    Positive replies are routed fast, meetings land in your calendar and every opportunity is tracked in your CRM, so outbound shows up as real pipeline.

Case study

How Aktive Clients built $1.2M in pipeline with smart outbound

Aktive Clients needed a reliable way to start conversations with the right prospects at scale. We ran the full Smart Outbound Framework for them: AI-targeted lists, personalised cold email and LinkedIn outreach working side by side, and every opportunity tracked through to pipeline.

Email

Cold email that gets opened and answered

Across two campaigns we reached more than 10,000 prospects. Strong deliverability and targeting kept open rates between 89% and 94%, and personalised sequences generated 669 replies, with the larger campaign reaching a 6.7% reply rate.

LinkedIn

LinkedIn outreach alongside email

In parallel, LinkedIn campaigns reached the same kind of decision-makers from a second angle. 715 connection requests led to 187 new connections, a 26% acceptance rate, and 76 replies from 267 messages sent.

Pipeline

Replies turned into real pipeline

Every positive reply was followed up and tracked, so outbound activity showed up where it matters: $1.2M in opportunity value across Aktive Clients' pipelines.

Common questions

Will cold email hurt our domain reputation?

No. We send from separate, properly warmed domains and keep volumes within safe limits, so your main domain stays protected.

Why use email and LinkedIn together?

Prospects who see you in more than one place are more likely to reply. Running both channels also means you're not dependent on a single platform.

Who writes the messages?

We do, based on your input and our research. You approve the messaging before anything goes out.

How soon will we see replies?

Once infrastructure is warmed up, most campaigns start producing replies within the first few weeks after launch.
